propositions: A completion verify run with a banked operator-actionable BLOCK that encounters a provider outage must finalize a deterministic FAIL verdict from the bank without additional LLM calls instead of dying verdict-less.

When the criterion bank holds an operator-actionable BLOCK (met=False, evidence_sufficient not False), the degrade surfaces the banked findings as a non-certifiable FAIL that flows to close_precheck's non-close branch, requiring operator decision.
An empty-bank or PASS-only-bank provider outage must re-raise the LLMUnavailableError unchanged to preserve the exit-11 retryable retry posture per ADR 0040.
The degrade path is guarded so any fault in bank read or verdict assembly falls through to re-raise, never introducing a new failure mode on the outage path.
The degrade uses only in-process logic (filesystem bank read + existing deterministic assembler) with zero billable LLM calls, honoring the module's 'can never die verdict-less' invariant.
